points.point: What the 'No LinkedIn pages found' message means
points.sentence: This message appears in the Select LinkedIn pages window after your LinkedIn sign-in succeeds.

points.point: Whether the message is an error
Analyst role, so should the Page be listed
points.sentence: It means the signed-in profile has no company Pages where it holds the Super Admin or Content Admin role.

points.point: Whether the personal profile connection worked
points.sentence: Your personal LinkedIn profile remains connected.

verdict.reason: This entry explains the exact message the customer sees and says only Super Admin or Content Admin roles list a Page, which plainly leaves out an Analyst.
